1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Start with x equal to the extended image g.
3. Run the denoiser on x.
4. Solve the linear system for the next x with the FFT, with the denoised image held fixed.
5. Repeat, then crop the last x to the image.
